2009.rothCatchUpWageThreshold_source: §414(v)(7)(A) was enacted by SECURE 2.0 and is not operative for this year; the table carries the statutory $145,000 base inertly
2009.iraCatchUp50_source: statutory flat $1,000 under §219(b)(5)(B)(ii); not COLA-adjusted before 2024, so absent from the COLA notices
2009.traditionalCoveredPhaseout_source: Notice 2008-102 publishes the applicable dollar amounts under §219(g)(3)(B)(i) (joint return or qualifying widow(er)) and §219(g)(3)(B)(ii) (all other taxpayers other than married filing separately), which are the band starts; unlike the notices from 2013 on it does not print the ranges themselves. Each end is the start plus the width fixed by §219(g)(2)(A)(ii): $10,000, or $20,000 on a joint return. The married-filing-separately start is the zero applicable dollar amount at §219(g)(3)(B)(iii). See usc-26-219.
2009.traditionalSpouseCoveredPhaseout_source: Start from Notice 2008-102 (§219(g)(7)(A)); the end is the start plus the $10,000 width that §219(g)(7)(B) substitutes for §219(g)(2)(A)(ii) in the spouse-covered case. See usc-26-219. The married-filing-separately band is published by no notice. §219(g)(7)(A) replaces only the joint applicable dollar amount, so a married individual filing a separate return keeps the zero fixed by §219(g)(3)(B)(iii), and §219(g)(7)(B) substitutes a $10,000 width for §219(g)(2)(A)(ii). §219(g)(4) removes spouses who lived apart for the whole year from the subsection altogether, which is why the data names this band 'living together'. See usc-26-219.
2009.rothPhaseout_source: Starts from Notice 2008-102, which cites them as §408A(c)(3)(C)(ii)(I) and (II); the same limits are §408A(c)(3)(B)(ii)(I) and (II) in the current Code, a relettering with no change in substance. Each end is the start plus the width fixed by §408A(c)(3)(A)(ii): $15,000, or $10,000 on a joint return or for a married individual filing a separate return, whose applicable dollar amount is zero under §408A(c)(3)(B)(ii)(III). See usc-26-408A.

_electiveDeferralComment: Section 402(g)(1) and section 457(e)(15) have been identical in every year listed. 2013 and 2014 are established by IR-2013-86 ('remains unchanged at $17,500' for 2014, which fixes 2013 at the same amount); 2015 by IR-2014-99; 2016 onward by the named notice.
